policies.name: system-worker-v2
policies.description: apps/worker, one client per facility (#60). Each membership binds %facility to that facility, so Medplum confines every job to it: a job never reads or writes another facility's data, and AI agent tools get the same limit. Only the resource types its jobs touch: worklist Tasks (P12) to start with. A job that needs another type adds it here, facility-scoped, in the same PR, with a policy test. v1 (Task with no facility criteria) is retired.
